scope: All six substantive body-flow citation claims, all four bibliography entries, the complete canonical publication source set, closest-prior-result comparison, user-library relevance, and bibliography coverage were checked; the negative novelty screen is bounded and is not a priority claim.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage claim freeze followed by sequential primary-source manual verification using the citation-check search protocol, publisher/arXiv/Preprints full-text locators, and final BibTeX/AUX/log consistency checks.
